//: Sliding collapsible 'Para' stock unique to the M249. Goes in the 'stock mount' slot the MGs use instead of a normal buttstock.
description: The collapsing tubular 'Para' stock developed for the paratrooper M249.  It slides closed to shorten the weapon dramatically for jumps and vehicles, then extends to a firing length.  Mounts to the squad automatic's stock interface rather than a standard buttstock.

//: M4-pattern collapsible (non-folding) stock fitted to an M240's stock mount.
description: An M4-style multi-position collapsible buttstock adapted to fit a medium machine gun's stock interface.  It slides to several length-of-pull positions to shorten the weapon, but unlike a side-folder it cannot fold flat.  A common field modification to tame the unwieldy length of a belt-fed gun.
